reference_transcript_policy: Manifest/reference transcripts are treated as already human-reviewed ground truth for WER/CER scoring; this audit does not require a new transcript review.

verdict.wer_formula: compliant edit-distance formula when token unit is declared
verdict.legacy_stored_wer: not journal-compliant as paper-facing evidence for unsegmented Chinese

notes: Use corpus-level micro CER as the primary Chinese ASR surface metric.
Use corpus-level micro zh-jieba WER only as a supplemental segmented-word metric.
Treat raw or undocumented stored WER fields as audit-only legacy values.
